
		<h1 class="postTitle">
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/fqxy/p/22763744" title="发布于 2026-08-30 18:59">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">k8s安装metrics-server，以及相关报错排查</span>
    

</a>

		</h1>
		<div class="clear"></div>
		<div class="postBody">
			<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>背景：有监控node节点pod的CPU等资源，实现自动扩缩容的需要下，需要安装metrics-server</p>
<p>k8s版本：1.30.14（kubadm安装） 对应metrics-server版本：0.8x（本文使用0.8.1）</p>
<p>1、下载部署清单</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>wget https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">github.com/kubernetes-sigs/metrics-server/releases/download/v0.8.1/components.yaml</span></pre>
</div>
<p>2、修改components.yaml配置文件</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">containers:
</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> args:
  </span>- --cert-dir=/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tmp
  </span>- --secure-port=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10250</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  # ... 可能还有其他参数 ...
  </span>- --kubelet-insecure-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">tls  # 添加这一行（添加）
  image: registry.k8s.io</span>/metrics-server/metrics-server:v0.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8.1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> # 您的镜像地址（修改）
  name: metrics</span>-server</pre>
</div>
<p>3、部署与验证</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>kubectl apply -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f components.yaml
# 查看 metrics</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server Pod 是否运行正常
kubectl </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span> pods -n kube-system -l k8s-app=metrics-server<br>（最好是kubectl get all -A|grep metrics-server验证）</pre>
<p>ubuntu@VM-0-4-ubuntu:~$ kubectl get all -A|grep metrics-server<br>kube-system        pod/metrics-server-588d67bbf8-k8gjm            1/1     Running   0              98m<br>kube-system        service/metrics-server                    ClusterIP   10.50.168.106   &lt;none&gt;        443/TCP                  98m<br>kube-system        deployment.apps/metrics-server            1/1     1            1           98m<br>kube-system        replicaset.apps/metrics-server-588d67bbf8            1         1         1       98m</p>
</div>
<p>如果 Pod 状态为 <code>Running</code>，通常表示安装成功。<span>kubectl top nodes会有数据</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ubuntu@VM-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-ubuntu:~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$ kubectl top nodes
NAME            CPU(cores)   CPU</span>%   MEMORY(bytes)   MEMORY%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   
vm</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-ubuntu   81m          <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>%     2006Mi          <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">55</span>%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       
vm</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span>-ubuntu   57m          <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>%     1042Mi          <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">56</span>% </pre>
</div>
<p>5、版本兼容性</p>
<p>不同版本的 metrics-server 对 Kubernetes 集群有兼容性要求。选择版本时，请务必参考官方或云服务商提供的兼容性矩阵。</p>
<p>​​​​​​​6、生产环境安全<br>在上述示例中，我们使用了 --kubelet-insecure-tls 参数来跳过证书验证，这仅在测试环境中推荐使用。在生产环境中，为了安全起见，你应该配置和使用有效的  TLS 证书。<br>7、重点来了，安装过程中遇到的问题</p>
<p>由于我们是kubadm安装，因此本文不讲二进制安装k8s后再部署metrics-server问题。kubadm安装的k8s，基本不用考虑apiservice链路聚合问题，二进制安装才会考虑，进而修改api配置文件。</p>
<p>先描述下我们遇到的问题：</p>
<p>kubectl get all -A|grep metrics-server检查时，server，pod，deployment都没问题，但是<em id="__mceDel" style="font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; font-size: 12px"><span>kubectl top nodes报错，这个时候就需要排查metrics-server最重要的一个东西：apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io，这个api是<em id="__mceDel">metrics-server向k8s注册的一个api接口，主要负责的就是通过k8s获取各个节点pod的cpu等资源使用情况，下面展示下排查细节</em></span></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ubuntu@VM-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-ubuntu:~$ kubectl <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io
NAME                     SERVICE                      AVAILABLE                      AGE
v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io   kube</span>-system/metrics-server   False (FailedDiscoveryCheck)   139m</pre>
</div>
<p>可以看到api状态False，接着看详细描述</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ubuntu@VM-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-ubuntu:~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$ kubectl describe apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io
Name:         v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io
Namespace:    
Labels:       k8s</span>-app=metrics-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
Annotations:  </span>&lt;none&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
API Version:  apiregistration.k8s.io</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
Kind:         APIService
Metadata:
  Creation Timestamp:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span>-30T08:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">09</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:10Z
  Resource Version:    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">38004</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  UID:                 ceda4901</span>-435b-425f-ab56-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">b0abaa5c9348
Spec:
  Group:                     metrics.k8s.io
  Group Priority Minimum:    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Insecure Skip TLS Verify:  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Service:
    Name:            metrics</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
    Namespace:       kube</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">system
    Port:            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Version:           v1beta1
  Version Priority:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Status:
  Conditions:
    Last Transition Time:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span>-30T10:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:28Z
    Message:               failing or missing response </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">10.50.168.106:443/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1: Get "</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://10.50.168.106</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">:443/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Reason:                FailedDiscoveryCheck
    Status:                False
    Type:                  Available
Events:                    </span>&lt;none&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>看，报错metrics-server的&nbsp;ClusterIP 10.50.168.106&nbsp; &nbsp;443链接超时</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>vim /etc/kubernetes/manifests/kube-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiserver.yaml
添加
</span>- --tls-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span>-key-file=/etc/kubernetes/pki/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">apiserver.key
</span>- --enable-aggregator-routing=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">（添加该参数）
会临时解决报错443超时（不建议使用）</span></pre>
</div>
<p>但是这会引起另一个类似报错是metrics-server的pod 10250超时</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ubuntu@VM-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>-ubuntu:~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">$ kubectl describe apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io
Name:         v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io
Namespace:    
Labels:       k8s</span>-app=metrics-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
Annotations:  </span>&lt;none&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
API Version:  apiregistration.k8s.io</span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">v1
Kind:         APIService
Metadata:
  Creation Timestamp:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span>-30T08:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">09</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:10Z
  Resource Version:    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">38004</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  UID:                 ceda4901</span>-435b-425f-ab56-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">b0abaa5c9348
Spec:
  Group:                     metrics.k8s.io
  Group Priority Minimum:    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Insecure Skip TLS Verify:  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Service:
    Name:            metrics</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
    Namespace:       kube</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">system
    Port:            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">443</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  Version:           v1beta1
  Version Priority:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
Status:
  Conditions:
    Last Transition Time:  </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2026</span>-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span>-30T10:<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">08</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:28Z
    Message:               failing or missing response </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//10.60.139.19</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">:10250/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1: Get "</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1); text-decoration: underline">https://10.60.139.19</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">:10250/apis/metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1": net/http: request canceled (Client.Timeout exceeded while awaiting headers)</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    Reason:                FailedDiscoveryCheck
    Status:                False
    Type:                  Available
Events:                    </span>&lt;none&gt;</pre>
</div>
<p>到现在，我们弄清楚了报错信息，但是还要找原因</p>
<p>先说根本原因：网络不通（不要想什么api聚合问题，就是网络原因）</p>
<p>为什么我笃定是网络原因呢，因此就这个问题我排查了2天，api聚合链路，metrics-server配置文件什么的各种参数，甚至k8s我都重装了一遍，网上也各种搜索，有的文章也说到了是网络问题，但是给出的解决方案安全性不高，基于此才想把该问题分享下</p>
<p>先说下网上的解决方案：</p>
<p>在metrics-server配置文件里加一个参数</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>      serviceAccountName: metrics-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">server
      hostNetwork: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> #（加的参数）
      volumes:
      </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> emptyDir: {}
        name: tmp</span>-dir</pre>
</div>
<p>该参数确实能解决以上我们遇到的问题，但是会增加风险：暴露宿主机网络、端口冲突、安全性下降</p>
<p>那么有没有什么更安全的解决方案呢？有的。其实能遇到443,10250链接超时问题的小伙伴，我想大多数应该都是在云主机上搭建的测试环境（或者是本地环境的网络配置有问题）</p>
<p>我的环境就是腾讯云主机的环境，基于此分析，那么为什么我们443,10250会超时就很简单了，就是因为calico vxlan模式使用的是4789端口UDP协议，但是云防火墙该端口协议没开！！！</p>
<p>只要我们在云主机防火墙规则打开4789端口UDP协议就可以，不用其他什么配置</p>
<p><img alt="捕获" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1384371/202608/1384371-20260830185204348-546969162.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>至于本地环境的小伙伴，依据此问题判断，大概率就是路由器规则不允许4789端口UDP协议通行导致的</p>
<p>当然，这只是本人遇到的443,10250超时的一种情况，若是有其他情况，欢迎补充。</p>

</div>
